about.lead: I enjoy finding the signal in the noise. From cleaning raw records to building an interactive report, I care about the whole journey from question to insight.
about.body: Currently in my 5th semester at the University of Gujrat, I have hands-on experience supporting the Business Intelligence team at Zameen.com. My toolkit spans SQL, Python, Excel, and Power BI, with a practical focus on analysis that people can actually use.
